title: ValueFormer: Stage-Aware Value Labels for Online Failure Detection and VLA Post-Training
abstract: arXiv:2608.02958v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generalist vision-language-action (VLA) policies now transfer to new scenes with little task-specific training, but they still fail silently: from the action stream alone, a collapsing rollout looks much like one making clean progress, because imitation supplies no notion of progress. The cheap alternative, a terminal success / failure bit, is learnable in principle yet too sparse to say when a rollout went wrong. We argue that the per-frame label is the hard part, and that it works better when continuous and non-monotonic: a score rather than a single success or failure, and one free to fall and then rise again as a rollout goes wrong and recovers. Such a label is cheap to obtain: a person marks only the stage at which an episode went wrong, and the per-frame values are computed from that. We present ValueFormer, a policy-agnostic causal transformer (3.5M parameters) over a frozen DINOv3 backbone, emitting two per-frame signal

translated_title: ValueFormer：用于在线失败检测与VLA后训练的阶段感知价值标签
translated_abstract: 通用视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略如今只需少量任务特定训练即可迁移到新场景，但它们仍会“无声地失败”：仅从动作流来看，一次即将崩溃的回合执行与一次顺利推进的执行几乎没有区别，因为模仿学习本身不提供关于任务进展的概念。一个廉价的替代方案是回合终止时的成功/失败标记，它原则上可学习，但过于稀疏，无法指出回合究竟在何时出了问题。我们认为逐帧标签才是真正的难点，而连续且非单调的标签效果更好：它是一个分数而非单一的成功或失败判定，并允许在回合出错时下降、随后随恢复而回升。这样的标签获取成本低廉：人工只需标注回合在哪个阶段出了问题，逐帧价值即可由此计算得出。我们提出ValueFormer——一个策略无关的因果Transformer（350万参数），构建于冻结的DINOv3骨干网络之上，可输出两种逐帧信号（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出ValueFormer，通过人工仅标注出错阶段即可低成本生成的连续、非单调逐帧价值标签，实现VLA策略的在线失败检测与后训练。
en_tdlr: ValueFormer introduces cheap, stage-aware per-frame value labels—continuous and non-monotonic, derived from a human marking only the stage where an episode went wrong—to enable online failure detection and post-training for VLA policies.
